newsitem.title: USA: American Century in talks with J.P. Morgan.
newsitem.headline: American Century in talks with J.P. Morgan.

text.p: Mutual fund company American Century Cos. said on Monday it was discussing the sale of a minority stake to J.P. Morgan & Co Inc.

American Century spokesman Gunnar Hughes declined to offer details about the talks except to say that no agreement had yet been reached and that any deal would be for a minority stake in American Century.

Reading from a brief company statement, Hughes said, "We are in discussions with J.P. Morgan about a proposed transaction in which Morgan would purchase a minority (non-controlling) interest in American Century Cos."
A J.P. Morgan spokesman declined comment on the matter.
A deal with American Century would fill a void at J.P. Morgan, which has a very limited presence in retail-type businesses such as mutual fund management.
Of J.P. Morgan's roughly $222 billion in assets under management, about $29 billion are mutual fund assets. American Century manages $58 billion in fund assets.
